name: Accessories
description: Magical and mundane jewelry, amulets, rings, belts, and torcs in The Elder Scrolls: Arena

entries.content: Amulet: An enchanted neckpiece worn against the chest. Often set with cut gemstones or inscribed with arcane runes that bolster the wearer's inner fortitude, intellect, or spiritual resilience.
Ring: An enchanted finger band forged from precious metals. Enchanters frequently bind defensive wards, elemental protections, or spell triggers into their loops.
Belt: A leather or metal-studded cinch worn about the waist. In addition to securing scabbards and pouches, enchanted girdles can ease the physical burden of heavy loads and fortify stamina.
Bracer: Forearm bands worn over the wrists. Favored by archers and duelists to steady their aim and deflect close-range weapon grazes.
Torc: An open-ended rigid metal neck ring favored in ancient Nord and Reachman tradition. Often imbued with primal warding enchantments that deflect hostile spells.
